topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement's complexity.

topics.label: Foundations of Complement and the Central Role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: They establish the foundational principles, naming conventions, and central biochemical hub of the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the three activation pathways that initiate the complement cascade by converging on C3 convertase.

topics.label: Effector Functions of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the primary effector mechanisms used by complement to eliminate pathogens and promote inflammation.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the host regulatory proteins and mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging self cells.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It details the distinct clinical manifestations and pathologies caused by deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: It examines the evolutionary strategies and mechanisms used by pathogens to evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It marks the conclusion of the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on adaptive immunity.
